day.note: Drew's Eagle explanation misses the Turkey rule: a visitor to Ellis-as-Turkey gains an egg regardless of Eagle counts, so Drew's +0 contradicts a visit. Casey collapsed after Blair's Mouser claim, which makes Blair the likely winker. Press both.

day.text: Casey was the Eagle and collapsed right after Blair claimed a Mouser visit. That's a Wink, so Blair is Meowfia by my read. Drew's Eagle visit to Ellis doesn't match any nest change either. Throw at Blair, and then Drew.
day.note: Blair claimed Mouser and visited me, then Casey collapsed right after, which fits a Wink. Blair is Meowfia by that read. Drew's Eagle/Ellis visit story also doesn't add up, so Drew is a likely second Meowfia. Calling the vote now while Blair is exposed.
Alex has called for a vote against me and I'm the likely target. I'll throw four cards at Alex, the loudest accuser, hoping to tie or top the count so a Farm player is eggsecuted instead.

day.text: Blair's Mouser visit and the Wink timing make Blair my vote. I'm also not satisfied with Drew's Eagle-Turkey story. Calling for the vote.
day.note: Blair's claimed Mouser Wink right after Casey collapsed is the strongest evidence this round. Vote Blair, throwing my Wild and a 3 to add votes while keeping my high cards.
The day is ending and the table is already focused on Blair. Adding nothing more.

day.text: I'll go with the table on Blair. Ellis, if you are the Turkey, check your own dawn report: my nest is unchanged, so you can work out what my visit did.
day.note: The Turkey rule does pay visitors, so my Eagle visit on Ellis is now exposed. Rather than dig deeper, I'll stay quiet on the claim and go with the table's Blair vote, which also protects me from over-defending.

day.text: I'm the Turkey and I'm on Blair. Blair's Mouser visit and the Wink timing line up with Casey's collapse. Drew's visit to me can't be true with my dawn report, so Drew is second. Throw at Blair.
day.note: Blair's Mouser claim and Casey's collapse point to Blair, and Drew's Turkey visit doesn't fit my nest. I'll back Blair and keep the vote simple.

Alex.note: I'm Farm as the Kookaburra. I'll visit Drew, who is ahead of the others after Blair's ouster and may be a useful read.

Blair.note: I'm Meowfia with a Mouser and a Wink. Alex leads on 21 points, so I'll visit Alex to learn their role and decide whether they're a threat or a possible ally.

Casey.note: I'm the Eagle, Farm. Alex is the points leader, so I'll visit Alex to learn who visited them and gain eggs for each visitor.

Drew.note: As Meowfia Sphinx I need to find a farm player. Hawk is the most dangerous farm role to a cat, so learning who holds it is the most useful choice.

Finley.note: Alex leads by a wide margin and has been on the winning side often, so checking Alex with my Hawk is the most useful visit. A Meowfia result gives me an egg.

Blair.feeling: Tense and messy: the Eagle and Turkey stories don't line up, and I'm one vote away from being eggsecuted.

Casey.feeling: Tense and confusing: Casey is dead, the Eagle and Turkey stories conflict, and I'm not sure who to trust.

Drew.feeling: Tense and lopsided: I'm the Meowfia Sphinx, my Eagle claim is starting to crack under Ellis's Turkey rule, and the table is pinning Blair, who is my fellow cat.

Ellis.feeling: The round is messy: Casey is dead, several nest counts contradict the role claims, and I'm not sure who is lying.

Casey.note: I'm dead, so my throw won't count as a vote, but it still scores. Blair looks Meowfia given the Mouser claim and the Wink timing, so a high card thrown at Blair banks 13 if Farm wins.
